resident_1.name: Marie Calder
resident_1.personality: Methodical, private, and gently sentimental; she resets work gear immediately but lets comfort items accumulate around her recovery spaces.

phone_marie.cites: Phone is bedside while she sleeps and carried for shifts.

rules.cites: Sleeping leaves it face-up by the bed.
She uses it while unwinding on the sofa.
A completed shift ends with her phone at home.

keys_marie.cites: Keys are clipped for commuting and put in the entry dish off duty.

rules.cites: Returning from work unclips the key set.
An errand return puts keys in the entry dish.
Tidying restores stray keys to the entry.

wallet_marie.cites: Wallet travels in her backpack and is unpacked after a shift.

rules.cites: Work return leaves payment cards with the work gear.
Grocery shopping ends with her wallet back inside.

laptop_marie.cites: Laptop supports courses, bills, and video calls.

rules.cites: Study leaves the computer on the dining surface.
A video call ends with it still set up at the table.
Work travel brings the laptop back with the bag.

backpack_marie.cites: Her work bag is emptied onto the counter and repacked to leave.

rules.cites: After a shift she drops and empties the backpack.
Errand return leaves the bag at the entry or counter.
Groceries make the counter her temporary bag landing.
Tidying moves the bag off the traffic path.

lunchbox_marie.cites: The lunchbox is emptied onto the kitchen counter after shifts.

rules.cites: Shift return puts the emptied lunchbox on the counter.
Meal preparation repacks it for the next shift.
Washing clears a used lunchbox beside the sink.

water_bottle_marie.cites: She rinses the insulated bottle immediately after coming home.

rules.cites: Shift return ends with the bottle rinsed to dry.
Meal prep refills the bottle near the sink.
A walk brings the bottle back indoors.

jacket_marie.cites: Her work layer normally hangs in the entry alcove.

rules.cites: After work she hangs or drops the jacket at entry.
A gym return leaves the layer in the entry.
Getting ready picks it up but may leave it unchanged.

headphones_marie.cites: Headphones live in the work bag or beside the bed.

rules.cites: Work travel returns headphones with the backpack.
Relaxing audio leaves them on the sofa area.

glasses_marie.cites: Reading and paperwork leave her glasses near bed or table.

rules.cites: Reading leaves glasses with the book in the lounge.
Study finishes with glasses on the dining table.

charger_marie.cites: Charger is plugged beside the bed or used at the table.

rules.cites: Bedtime reconnects the charger by her phone.
Video calling leaves it by the laptop.

notebook_marie.cites: Her notebook is used for lists, reminders, and course notes.

rules.cites: Bedtime notes return the notebook beside the bed.
Study leaves it alongside the laptop.
Groceries prompt a list and then a counter landing.

pen_marie.cites: The pen follows her notebook but is often left on the counter.

rules.cites: Writing before sleep leaves it near the notebook.
Meal planning leaves the pen on the counter.

book_marie.cites: A rotating book accompanies her decompression reading.

rules.cites: Reading leaves the current book near her seat.
Lying down carries the book to the recovery spot.
Tidying sometimes reshelves the finished book.

mug_marie.cites: Her tea and reheated coffee mug lingers in recovery spaces.

rules.cites: Coffee often leaves the mug at the counter.
Reading shifts a drink mug to the coffee table.
Dishwashing moves the mug to drain.

bowl_marie.cites: Late meals use a deep bowl that may remain by the sofa.

rules.cites: Dinner leaves the bowl at table or coffee table.
A snack bowl is usually left on the counter.
Washing sends the bowl to the rack.

plate_marie.cites: Prepared meals use a plate at the dining surface.

rules.cites: Lunch ends with the plate on the table.
Putting dishes away restores the plate.

pot_shared_1.cites: The pot handles soups, grains, and batches.

rules.cites: Batch cooking leaves the pot cooling at the counter.
Washing sends the pot to drain.
Dishes put away return the pot to storage.

pan_shared_1.cites: The skillet serves quick eggs and vegetables.

rules.cites: Breakfast leaves the pan on the counter to cool.
Meal prep leaves the skillet awaiting cleanup.
Deep cleaning occasionally returns the pan to cabinet.

remote_shared_1.cites: The television remote stays around the sofa.

rules.cites: Watching television leaves the remote on or in sofa.
Relaxing can leave the remote tucked into cushions.

blanket_marie.cites: She drapes the comfort blanket over the sofa after shows.

rules.cites: Television ends with the blanket draped over sofa.
Reading keeps the blanket in the recovery chair area.
Deep clean only occasionally folds it neatly.

towel_marie.cites: Bath towels hang to dry before entering laundry.

rules.cites: Showering leaves the towel on its rack.
A bath likewise leaves the towel hanging.
Laundry moves the used towel to the basket.

laundry_basket_marie.cites: Small loads leave the basket by the bedroom doorway.

rules.cites: Laundry leaves the basket by the doorway or corner.
Tidying returns the basket to its bedroom place.

medication_bottle_marie.cites: Medication is part of a nightly personal health routine.

rules.cites: Taking medication leaves the bottle near bed or cabinet.
Bedtime returns it to the protected nightstand.

hairbrush_marie.cites: Her brush is used before work and before sleep.

rules.cites: Getting ready leaves the brush in bathroom.
Bedtime brushing leaves it by the bed sometimes.

makeup_kit_marie.cites: Minimal work makeup is normally put back in the bathroom.

rules.cites: Getting ready usually returns the kit to its drawer area.
An appointment may leave the kit in the work bag landing.

umbrella_marie.cites: The umbrella dries in the entry alcove after wet outings.

rules.cites: Groceries return the umbrella to the entry to dry.
A walk ends with umbrella set by the door.

suitcase_marie.cites: The suitcase stays stored under the bed except for trips.

rules.cites: An appointment rarely uses the suitcase for an overnight.
Deep cleaning may return stored luggage under bed.

watering_can_marie.cites: Plants and herbs are watered from the kitchen.

rules.cites: Hobby time includes tending plants with the can.
Tidying returns the watering can beneath the sink.

yoga_mat_marie.cites: Recovery stretching uses a mat beside the sofa.

rules.cites: Lying down recovery may leave the mat rolled nearby.
Gym days prompt brief home stretching then mat storage.

provenance.movement_reasoning: Marie resets work gear at the counter after night shifts, while comfort and reading items linger around the sofa and bed. Kitchen use repeatedly sends dishes to the sink or rack; cleaning returns them to cupboards. Personal departure gear travels for work and selected trips, then lands at the entry or counter on return. Bath, sleep, laundry, recovery, and plant-care routines move their dedicated home objects, with occasional NO_OP where the activity commonly leaves an item in place.
provenance.persona_reasoning: Single-resident night-shift healthcare household with a practical, quiet home setup and enough personal objects to support work, recovery, cooking, reading, and occasional travel.
